sentences.japanese: 俺を洗い清めろ！俺を解放しろ！俺を自由にしろ！
sentences.english: Cleanse me! Release me! Set me free!

sentences.japanese: あの赤い布は「袱紗」茶道具を清めるために使う必需品なの。
sentences.english: That red cloth is a "fukusa"; it is a vital tool used to cleanse the tea equipment.

sentences.japanese: 心の清い人たちは幸いである。
sentences.english: Blessed are the pure in heart.

sentences.japanese: 私の心と思いとを練り清めてください。
sentences.english: Try out my reins and my heart.

sentences.japanese: 縁起に塩をまいて清める。
sentences.english: We sprinkle salt to ward off bad luck.
